name: Lena Forst
source: Lena Forst spent her formative years in the wooded countryside, raised by eccentric free spirits. She often finds herself wandering in her own little world, but is eager to let others know just what's on her mind. In the school newspaper, Lena is able to put her piercing curiosity and sarcastic demeanour to good use. Lena is unashamed of her odd habits; in fact, she seems to revel in being misunderstood by her peers.
